entries.definition: implied though not directly expressed; inherent in the nature of something
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Built as 'not explicit', it sees the telling as falling short, where *implicit* sees a quality of the thing itself.

entries.definition: not made explicit
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Sounds clinical: the gap is a failure to put something into words, not a silence with any weight to it.

entries.definition: exhibiting or calling for sportsmanship or fair play
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Praises by what is missing - nothing foul in the play - where *sportsmanlike* names the good quality directly.

entries.definition: free from favoritism or self-interest or bias or deception; conforming with established standards or rules
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Plain approval no one can argue with: it confirms nobody was favored or tricked, without the weight of principle *just* carries.

entries.definition: beyond or deviating from the usual or expected
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Flatly notes that something strays from the usual or expected, with none of *peculiar*'s second look.

entries.definition: expressing or manifesting praise or approval
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Formal to the point of stiffness - the same praise as *approving*, raised into official language.

entries.definition: being favorably inclined
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The mildest here: a leaning in someone's favour, not praise, so nothing has to be shown as it does with *approving*.

entries.definition: not appropriate in application; defective
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Formal and softened: it calls a thing unsuited to its use and faulty, while sounding sorry about it, where *inept* simply condemns.
examples: the infelicitous typesetting was due to illegible copy

entries.definition: not brought to the desired final state
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Faintly disapproving: it measures the thing against the final state that was wanted, so it records falling short, not just a stage.

entries.definition: natural and unstudied
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Approving, and sounds like easy talk: it praises being natural rather than put on, where *informal* only notes what is missing.

entries.definition: without ceremony or formality
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Pictures the ceremony or formality as stripped off, with an abrupt, blunt edge that *casual* never carries.

entries.definition: in a more fortunate or prosperous condition
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Built as a comparison - it always means better than something, and never says what.
examples: she would have been better off if she had stuck with teaching
is better off than his classmate

entries.definition: peculiarly fortunate or appropriate; as if by divine intervention
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Deeply thankful - the timing was so right it tempts you to say heaven stepped in.
examples: a heaven-sent rain saved the crops

entries.definition: most unfortunate or miserable
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Holds nothing back - misfortune or misery as bad as it gets, where *unfortunate* only notes that luck ran out.
examples: the most abject slaves joined in the revolt

entries.definition: (of events) having extremely unfortunate or dire consequences; bringing ruin
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Makes the ruin feel bound to happen, as though the outcome were fixed before the event - a heavy seriousness *disastrous* never claims.

entries.definition: physically or spiritually homeless or deprived of security
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The plain word, for someone without a roof or without inner security, with none of the sense of being wronged in *dispossessed*.

entries.definition: smelling like cedar
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Takes its smell from a wood and names the whole tree, where *balsam-scented* narrows to a resin.

entries.definition: smelling of cinnamon
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Warm where *mint-scented* is cool, but the warmth belongs to the spice, not the word, which names the smell flatly.

entries.definition: having odor or a characteristic odor
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The base word: having a smell, or a smell of its own, and the only one here that never says which smell.

entries.definition: having lost freshness through passage of time
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Understated, almost a gentler way to say *stale*: it notes only that time has passed and taken the freshness with it.
examples: dogs attempting to catch a cold scent

entries.definition: dried out
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Names lost moisture, not foulness: a fault of texture, with none of the disgust in *rotten* or *rancid*.
examples: hard dry rolls left over from the day before

entries.definition: spoiled and covered with eggs and larvae of flies
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The same eggs and larvae as *flyblown*, but with the crawling maggots right in front of you - the harder word to hear.

entries.definition: covered with or smelling of mold
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The gentlest of the three words for mold seen on the food or smelled off it, with none of *moldy*'s bluntness.

entries.definition: (used of decomposing oils or fats) having a rank smell or taste usually due to a chemical change or decomposition
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Names the strong, foul smell or taste of decaying fats and oils - an accusation from the senses, not *bad*'s bare ruling.

entries.definition: lacking freshness, palatability, or showing deterioration from age
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The plainest word for lost freshness - taste gone, or condition gone with age - where *bad* goes further: unfit to eat.

entries.definition: the act of hindering or obstructing or impeding
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The broadest of the three, covering holding back, blocking and slowing alike, and picturing the act as a course disrupted from outside.
examples: She looked at her father to entreat his interference, lest Mary should be singing all night.
never had she before been so much disposed to pardon his interference in the views of his friend

entries.definition: not functioning properly
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The gentlest word here — it notes that something is off without saying how far or how badly.

entries.definition: giving or spending with reluctance
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: A softer word: *close with money* is what you say when you do not want to say *stingy*.
examples: very close (or near) with his money
